# OpenZeppelin signature verification subset

These six Solidity files are unchanged copies of the signature verification dependency closure from the project's installed `@openzeppelin/contracts` 4.9.6 package. Source: [OpenZeppelin Contracts v4.9.6](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/tree/v4.9.6); [upstream MIT licence](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/v4.9.6/LICENSE).

`SignatureChecker` verifies signatures from externally owned accounts and
ERC-1271 contract wallets. This subset includes its dependencies ECDSA,
IERC1271, Strings, Math and SignedMath. The Solidity files retain their
upstream licence and notices.
